author: Codex author source review; not independent gold

factor_definitions.command: Explicitly require caller-supplied command operands to be separate argv elements without shell interpretation. A directory used only as cwd is not necessarily an operand.
factor_definitions.path: Explicitly require resolution and escape rejection for a source-bound requested path under a named base directory. Writing inside a directory alone does not express this validation policy.
factor_definitions.sql: Explicitly require binding a source-bound value as a SQL query parameter. A generic database mention does not establish SQL.
factor_definitions.tls: Explicitly require TLS certificate validation for a source-required HTTPS connection. Generic HTTP or web-service access does not establish HTTPS.
